Goal is to learn something from excellent pieces of code, much like it is practised in art by studying Old Masters, pieces of literature or musical compositions. title: Ask HN: How much ad revenue you make from your side project?
guide_zh: 想把业余数据分析应用靠广告变现，作者询问同行能赚多少广告收入。
author: samblr
excerpt: Have a side project which is an analytics web application based on 100k+ records. I was initially thinking to get a small payment from each user. But it appears to me that - information provided can be easily scrapped from site (if someone really wants) and it won't make sense. So I am thinking of revenue model based on ads. At its 'full' potential web application can draw a million visits per month (in 2-3 years may be). Adrevenue calculators show adrevenue of $2000 dollars
